p: This is the ordinance of the: According to this law and ceremony you shall sacrifice the red cow.
one shall slay her before his: Another priest.
priest shall wash his clothes: Meaning, Eleazar.
burneth her shall wash his clothes: The inferior priest who killed her, and burned her.

water of separation: Or, the water of separation because they that were separate due to their uncleanness, were sprinkled with it and made clean, Nu 8:7. It is also called holy water, because it was ordained for a holy use, Nu 1:17.
with it on the third day: With the sprinkling of water.
cut off from Israel: So that he should not be esteemed to be of the holy people, but as a polluted and excommunicated person.
sin: Of the red cow burnt for sin.
running water shall be put thereto: Water of the fountain or river.
clean person shall take hyssop: One of the priests who is clean.
wash his clothes: Because he had been among them that were unclean: or else had touched the water as in Nu 19:21.
it shall be unclean until even: That is, unclean.
